profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft focused on enabling AI at hyperscale. As part of the Copilot, Agents, and Platforms Growth Engineering team, I build the services that power access to Microsoft Copilot and AI experiences across PC, Mac, web, and mobile. I specialize in scalable, high-reliability systems that serve hundreds of millions of users worldwide, delivering measurable business impact through engineering excellence.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Copilot, Agents, and Platform Growth
Office Licensing Team
• Powered Microsoft Copilot and AI experiences across Windows, Mac, web, and mobile by building and operating a highly reliable hyperscale platform that governs feature access and entitlement for more than 500 million users worldwide in both commercial and consumer spaces.
• Played a key role in defining and delivering a Microsoft-wide Copilot access strategy that transformed free-tier eligibility for hundreds of millions of commercial users and tens of millions of tenants. Delivered a production-ready solution under an aggressive timeline, enabling broad-scale AI adoption across the Microsoft ecosystem.
• Led a cross-functional team of engineers and technical program managers to improve observability across the Microsoft Copilot license refresh journey. Aggregated signals from multiple services and clients into a dashboard that surfaces percentile latency and failure points, enabling leadership to track service health and engineers to identify regressions.
• Designed and developed a new suite of Eligibility APIs that unified multiple upstream signals into the authoritative source of record for commercial user upgrade eligibility. These services power critical AI growth journeys—including free trials, self-service purchases, and license acquisition—and provide a scalable foundation for future Microsoft AI and Copilot experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Experience + Devices Growth
Office Licensing Team

Security Platform
Policy Infrastructure and API Team
• Worked on a security policy distribution and notification service utilized in the M365 cloud environment and beyond. Our service is deployed on over 300k machines, utilized by millions of tenants, and serves on the order of tens of a billion requests per day.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Engineering Insights Team
• Designed and built a cloud compliance system to ensure best practices across all cloud resources, periodically scanning tens of thousands of resources across dozens of accounts, withs savings in the tens of thousands of dollars per month
• Led a team of three Software Engineers over the course of several months in retooling a cloud compute spending forecast and budgeting portal, including personally creating multiple system designs, hosting design reviews and participating in user studies
• Redesigned and implemented host resizing recommendations for deployed computing hosts, identifying hundreds of over-allocated hosts and finding potential savings in the tens of thousands of dollars per month
• Created a system of alerting teams when their cloud spending if outpacing their set budget by comparing metrics from both their spending and budget daily
